note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Strong wood-grain streaks on propeller blades; detail_gain 124.85 (others 0.7-29) suggests over-injected Wood051 texture, unlike the original's mottled surface.
flags.fix: Reduce detail injection strength to roughly the other units' range, colour-match from the original only, and drop or weaken the Wood051 grain.

flags.problem: Speckled, serrated rim around the dark disc with stray light specks at the edge, from grain bleeding into the mask boundary.
flags.fix: Keep the fitted AA circle edge clean: exclude the grain from a band of about 1px at the rim and smooth the mask ramp.

flags.problem: At 1:1 the rivet is soft and out of focus; the highlight mottle is lost and the dark ring and halo are blurred wider than the original (detail_gain 0.73). Note usage is null, so it is not placed in the world.
flags.fix: Sharpen the rim alpha ramp, restore the highlight mottle from the original, and keep the halo falloff close to the original's. Confirm it is needed before shipping.
